_doc: What ANSWERS each threat token, as a predicate over a plant record.
Predicate grammar (see model/requirements.py, ~40 lines, no dependencies):
{"any": [atom, ...]}   at least one must hold
{"all": [atom, ...]}   every one must hold
{"not": atom}          negation
atoms are strings:
"role:dps_aoe"        has the role at any band
"role:dps_aoe>=b3"    has it at that band or better
"element:fire"        carries the element
"flag:jester_safe"    carries the flag
"name:Blover"         is exactly this plant
"list:FIRE_AURA_PLANTS"  is in that constants.py list -- ALWAYS
prefer this over re-listing plants here,
because constants.py is what generation
actually reads and this file must not
become a second source of truth
`severity` is how a level's difficulty scales when the token is unanswered:
hard     the level is unwinnable; requirements.py emits a MUST rule
soft     the level is much harder; folds into the pressure multiplier
flavour  recorded for display, never gates anything
`answered_by_default` names tokens a normal loadout handles incidentally,
so the site can grey them out instead of implying a gate.

jester.why: returns straight-line projectiles at your own lawn; a reversible shot is worse than none

iceblock.why: arrives carrying ice blocks that freeze plants solid; only a standing WarmingRadius keeps a lawn workable

water.why: deep-water lanes hold nothing without a base

air.why: flies over ground plants; nothing on the lawn reaches it
air.current_rule: WORLD_ENTRY_PLANTS['Far Future'] (Blover, by decision not derivation)

garg.why: walks past chip damage and smashes a plant per step; needs burst or an instakill, not DPS

blocker.why: carries a screen door or shield that eats straight shots

hurdle.why: vaults the first wall it meets, so a wall alone does not hold the lane

burrow.why: travels under the lawn and surfaces behind the front line

summoner.why: adds zombies the wave table never priced, so the pressure curve understates it

camel.why: a structural module, not a walker; the level is a hump-matching puzzle
camel.current_rule: excluded from the zombie shuffle entirely (zombie_data.py)

zomboss.why: a scripted boss fight with its own HP pool and phases

graves.why: tombstones block tiles and keep spawning until removed
graves.current_rule: STRETCH_ENTRY_PLANTS Ancient Egypt / Dark Ages Mid+Late

gloom.why: a darkened lawn hides zombies until they are on top of you

tide.why: the water line advances and retreats, so lanes change shape mid-level

wind.why: gusts blow unrooted plants off the lawn

ice_terrain.why: frozen tiles slide plants and hold zombies

sandstorm.why: carries zombies deep into the lawn past the front line

minecart.why: rails let you move plants; helps rather than threatens

portals.why: zombies arrive behind the front line

beat.why: tempo changes zombie speed on a cycle

rain.why: puddles restrict planting on some tiles

lava.why: burning tiles destroy plants placed on them

raptor.why: dinos throw or pull zombies past your defence

conveyor.why: no plant chooser: the belt decides, so NO plant requirement can gate this level
conveyor.current_rule: randomize_conveyor_plants keeps belt swaps inside a power band

locked_slots.why: a forced or restricted seed selection

small_grid.why: fewer usable rows concentrates the same HP into less lawn

no_sun_drop.why: no falling sun at all: every plant must be paid for by a producer
no_sun_drop.current_rule: the sun-producer rule on every world entrance

endless.why: Danger Room: pressure rises without bound, so a clear is a soft target not a hard one

puzzle.why: not a lane fight; the pressure model does not apply

objective.why: a non-standard win condition (Last Stand, Protect the Plant, Plants to Die, a time limit) -- clearing it is not 'survive the waves', so the pressure curve is not the test

power_tiles.why: tiles that boost or link plants; they help rather than threaten, but they make a level's real output higher than its loadout suggests

trap_tiles.why: tiles that destroy what is placed on them, so part of the lawn is unusable until they are dealt with

potions.why: Dark Ages potions buff zombies mid-wave, so a wave's real HP is above what its table states

mold.why: mold colonies spread across the lawn and take tiles until they are cleared
